clue.text: Battles about top-class sales

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the battles word is wrapped round the other piece

parts.note: battles are military actions
U is the old British label for upper-class, hence top-class

explanation.surface: A report on fierce bidding wars at upmarket sales.
explanation.definitionFit: Auctions are sales where goods go to the highest bidder.

clue.text: Connected to the French ambassador's assistant

definitions.meaning: in French the past participle meaning fastened or connected is spelt this way
an embassy official on an ambassador's staff

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition asks for the French word for 'attached'; the second is the English borrowing of that word for an embassy staff member.
explanation.definitionFit: An attaché is a junior diplomat assisting an ambassador; the word is French for attached or connected.

clue.text: Life force seen in Greek writing

definitions.meaning: in Chinese thought, the vital energy flowing through the body
a letter of the Greek alphabet, written as X

explanation.definitionFit: Chi is both the Chinese vital energy (also qi) and the twenty-second Greek letter.

clue.text: Crazy old sister, a woman obsessed by her image

indicators.note: crazy suggests the letters of old sister and a are thrown into disorder

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A mad elderly nun has become fixated on a statue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crazy' rearranges OLD SISTER A, all ten letters, into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An idolatress is a female worshipper of idols, images treated as gods.

clue.text: One complaint raised in woman's name

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the pieces read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
a moan is a complaint

explanation.surface: Someone raised a grievance in a woman's name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns I + MOAN upwards, giving NAOMI.
explanation.definitionFit: Naomi is a female given name, from the Book of Ruth.

clue.text: Something good to put on black dog

indicators.note: the good thing is placed on top of, so after, the black piece

parts.note: B is the standard abbreviation for black, as on pencils
an asset is something good or useful

explanation.surface: Advice to back a black dog at the racetrack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put on' reads like placing a bet; here it says ASSET goes after B.
explanation.definitionFit: A basset is a short-legged hound breed.

clue.text: Side winds

definitions.meaning: side means pretentiousness, as in putting on side
breezes or light movements of air

explanation.definitionFit: Putting on airs is putting on side, meaning showing off; airs are also breezes.

clue.text: Conrad character moves centre stage

indicators.note: moves tells us the letters of centre stage shift into a new order

explanation.surface: An actor in a Joseph Conrad play steps into the spotlight.
explanation.definitionFit: Verloc is the title figure of Conrad's novel The Secret Agent, a spy.

clue.text: Rallying cry to others to share one's view

definitions.text: Rallying cry to others to share one's view

parts.words: Rallying cry to others to share one's view
parts.note: a fox-hunting shout telling the rest of the hunt that the quarry has been sighted, so they can see it too

explanation.definitionFit: Tally-ho is the huntsman's cry on sighting the fox, calling the field to follow.

clue.text: Cashier, penny short, strangely serene

indicators.note: strangely means the letters are arranged in an odd new order

parts.note: taken as written
P is the short form, or abbreviation, of penny

explanation.surface: A bank teller who is a penny down remains oddly calm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strangely' shuffles CASHIER with P into the answer; 'short' asks for the abbreviation of 'penny', not a deletion.
explanation.definitionFit: Seraphic means angelic, blissfully serene, like a seraph.

clue.text: Sin is one of these functions

definitions.text: Sin is one of these functions

parts.words: Sin is one of these functions
parts.note: sin is the shorthand for sine, a ratio of sides in a right-angled triangle, not wrongdoing

explanation.definitionFit: Sine, cosine and tangent are the functions of the mathematics of triangles.

clue.text: South American leading partner I'm able to follow

indicators.note: the second piece comes after the first

parts.note: a co-star shares the lead role in a film
I'm able means I can

explanation.surface: A dancer boasts of being able to keep up with the lead.
explanation.walkthrough: Costa Rica is strictly in Central America, but the setter treats it loosely as part of the Americas' south.
explanation.definitionFit: A Costa Rican comes from Costa Rica, in the southern part of North America, loosely called South American here.

clue.text: American chief in office, optimistic speculator

parts.note: a sitting MP or president is one currently holding office
on the stock market a bull buys expecting prices to rise

explanation.surface: A US company boss in post who is bullish on shares.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chief' sounds like a business boss; it is a Native American leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Sitting Bull was a Lakota Sioux chief, victor at Little Bighorn.

clue.text: Sort of light and jolly

definitions.meaning: a ... light is a coloured flare fired from a pistol
jolly in British use is an intensifier meaning extremely, as in jolly good

explanation.definitionFit: A Very light is a signal flare; very and jolly both mean extremely.

clue.text: Impractical high-rise building

parts.note: a lofty structure read as a figure for a retreat from practical life, such as academia

explanation.definitionFit: An ivory tower is a state of privileged seclusion from the realities of the world.

clue.text: Irritate with triumphant cry suffer humiliation

parts.note: to eat someone is to bother them, as in what's eating you
to crow is to exult loudly

explanation.surface: Gloating loudly over someone and then being humbled.
explanation.definitionFit: To eat crow is an idiom for being forced to admit a mistake humbly.

clue.text: Consider hearing speaker in south coast resort

indicators.note: hearing tells us a word is to be taken by its sound

parts.note: to weigh something is to consider it
the mouth is the organ that speaks

explanation.surface: Thinking about listening to a loudspeaker at the seaside.
explanation.definitionFit: Weymouth is a seaside town in Dorset on England's south coast.

clue.text: Take a turn and try to foil criminal

definitions.meaning: make an attempt, have one's go
in Britain a ... hero is a bystander who tackles a criminal

explanation.definitionFit: To have a go is to attempt something; it also means tackling a wrongdoer, as a have-a-go hero does.

clue.text: Deny state is associated with Georgia and Indiana

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state Georgia
IN is the postal abbreviation for Indiana
to state is to say

explanation.surface: Disputing which states are linked with Georgia and Indiana.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' looks like a US state alongside Georgia and Indiana but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To gainsay is to contradict or deny.

clue.text: Bird dog

definitions.meaning: a large vulture of the Old World
a wiry-coated breed of small dog

explanation.definitionFit: The griffon vulture is a bird, and the griffon is a dog breed.

clue.text: Warning about king riding into divisive situation

indicators.note: about means around, so the warning word surrounds the king

parts.note: cave, Latin for beware, is old British school slang for a lookout's warning
R is short for rex, Latin for king
up means on horseback, as a jockey is up

explanation.surface: A warning to a king riding into a dangerous split.
explanation.walkthrough: CAVE is schoolboy slang shouted when a teacher approaches.
explanation.definitionFit: A carve-up is a sharing out of spoils, a division that splits parties.

clue.text: It's put up to provide shade for mushroom

definitions.text: It's put up to provide shade
definitions.meaning: a sunshade opened above the head
a tall edible fungus with a broad cap

explanation.definitionFit: A parasol is a sunshade, and the parasol mushroom is named for its umbrella-like cap.

clue.text: Ancient one, in the past

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
ago means in the past

explanation.walkthrough: 'Ancient' is an old word for an ensign, the rank of Othello's officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Iago is called Othello's ancient, an old term for ensign.

clue.text: Rival of little importance thrown into lake, right?

indicators.note: thrown into means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: Como is an Italian lake
petit means minor, as in petit jury

explanation.surface: A minor opponent tossed into a lake, isn't that so?
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor is a rival in a contest.

clue.text: Religious work resulting from letters to the Corinthians

parts.note: the Corinthians wrote in Greek, so pi is one of their letters
eta is another letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A sacred piece inspired by St Paul's epistles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letters to the Corinthians' suggests the epistles; it means two Greek letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A pietà is a painting or sculpture of the Virgin Mary holding the dead Christ.

clue.text: It contributes to normal society, and national sovereignty,-too

indicators.note: the answer contributes letters to the words, lying inside them

explanation.surface: Something that adds to social normality and to a nation's independence.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer lies in 'normAL SOciety' and equally in 'nationAL SOvereignty', a second hiding place the clue adds for good measure.
explanation.definitionFit: Also means too, in addition.

clue.text: Bad language that lout uses, for example

definitions.text: Bad language that lout uses, for example

parts.words: Bad language that lout uses, for example
parts.note: swear words; and the word lout itself is an example of a word with four letters

explanation.definitionFit: Four-letter words are short obscenities, and lout has exactly four letters.

clue.text: Newspaper's way to raise money for charity

definitions.meaning: a disparaging word for a low-quality newspaper

definitions.text: way to raise money for charity
definitions.meaning: a British student charity event or week of stunts

explanation.definitionFit: A rag is a poor newspaper and also a British student charity fundraiser.

clue.text: Naval commander in the hold

definitions.meaning: Horatio, the admiral who won at Trafalgar
a wrestling hold with the arm under the opponent's and the hand on the neck

explanation.definitionFit: Admiral Nelson commanded at Trafalgar, and a nelson is a wrestling hold.

clue.text: Old song from European city not finished by lassie

indicators.note: not finished means the city name loses its final letter

parts.note: Madrid is the capital of Spain
a lassie is a girl, a gal

explanation.surface: An old tune from Madrid left incomplete by a girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not finished' drops the last D of MADRID.
explanation.definitionFit: A madrigal is a part-song, chiefly of the Renaissance.
